scope: US single regular federal rate schedules 2024–2026; AU resident gross rate schedules FY2024–25 through FY2027–28 enacted rate reduction. Same taxable income, before all credits and levies.
limitations: No full tax return, inflation adjustment, future offset modeling, historical deduction rules or prior-engine receipt execution. Archive comparison test detects unintended drift but is not an external immutable ledger.
